text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A series of new building regulations are to be introduced in Bahrain, aimed at increasing the number of buildings by 30 percent in less densely populated areas.
- Emir praises United States for safeguarding region's security.
- A $60 million automobile spare parts production plant is to be set up in Bahrain.
- Britain and Bahrain are stepping up cooperation in labour-related fields.

- Up to 5,000 Indians staying in Bahrain unlawfully were urged to respect an amnesty for illegal aliens. A three-month amnesty for all expatriates staying in the state illegally was announced last week.
- An official at water and electricity ministry warns of the possibility of exhausting ground water resources in 10 years.
- A group of alleged saboteurs confessed to setting a religious hall ablaze.
